{{Quote|It's them! Blast them!|Stormtrooper, first to spot Chewbacca, Leia Organa, Luke Skywalker, and Han Solo|<ref name="ANH" />}}
Serving the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|First Galactic Civil War]], this '''Stormtrooper''' was stationed onboard the [[Death Star/Legends|''Death Star'']] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] where he was part of a patrol. He was the first to notice the four rebels [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], who were trying to make it back to the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. Before he could react, he was shot by Han Solo, causing the rest of the stormtroopers to flee.
